text: Deleting the empty SetAdvancedSearchStatusText stub does not remove search status. SearchFolderDisplayWidget.onSearching toggles the stop/search label, clear-button state and progress visibility. Completion updates localized zero/count result text from dbView.rowCount. Message removal refreshes that count only when a search is not still in progress. Preserve these distinct transitions when changing search UI; no status announcement or search interaction was executed. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: Search status remains owned by the search display widget
